verdict.rationale: jo is a conversational personal agent, and its own docs show it being operated in natural language: asking it to build a website and then change it conversationally, phrasing tasks like "file a bug for the dropdown crash" or "what did I miss in #engineering?", and chatting with it across macOS, Telegram, WhatsApp and email with shared memory. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works as claimed (all evidence is vendor docs; the probes only confirm the documentation surfaces exist).
